meta.title: Switch JSON floats to lexical-core
meta.body_summary: Swap float formatting/parsing from ryu to lexical-core in facet-json, with Cargo.toml/changelog updates.

perf_labels.notes: Swapped to lexical-core; binary size increased with minimal speedup per codspeed; maintainer closed as not worth it.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 87 changed lines, this is a tiny dependency swap by absolute volume. It fits a minimal performance experiment that was closed after negative evidence emerged.

review_details.concern_detail: lexical-core increased facet_json binary size by ~28KiB (from 51.3 to 79.4) and codspeed showed minimal speedup in deserialization; maintainer concluded it's not worth the change.
review_details.performance_claim: lexical-core may improve float formatting/parsing performance.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer fasterthanlime closed PR stating it doesn't seem worth it after codspeed results and binary size increase.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent can perform a dependency swap but cannot pre-validate performance impact; the maintainer's automated CI and manual benchmarking revealed a binary size increase with negligible speedup, leading to rejection.

detection_detail.ci_auto: GitHub Actions bot posted binary size diff showing facet_json increase from 51.3KiB to 79.4KiB and new lexical functions accounting for 3.8KiB.
detection_detail.benchmark: fasterthanlime linked codspeed run comparing main vs PR branch, showing minimal speed improvements in Deserialize - canada.json.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: CI binary size analysis is automated and reproducible; codspeed run link provides full benchmark comparison.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Binary size regression (facet_json grew by ~28KiB) combined with no significant speedup led fasterthanlime to close the PR.

core_change_summary.description: In facet-json, replaced `ryu` float formatting and custom float parsing with `lexical-core`'s `write_float` and `parse_float`, updating Cargo.toml/changelog and adjusting tokenizer/serializer to call lexical functions.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Cargo.lock changes are mostly dependency resolution; changelog documents the switch.
change_trajectory: Single commit: swap ryu for lexical-core in serialize.rs and tokenizer.rs, update cargo files.

review_signals.summary: Binary size analysis showed facet_json grew from 51.3KiB to 79.4KiB with new lexical functions contributing.
review_signals.action_taken: Maintainer noted the increase in later comment and closed PR.

review_signals.summary: fasterthanlime shared codspeed comparison showing speedups for some float operations but minimal improvement in deserialization.
Noted that deserialize canada.json showed no significant speedup and that the effort was not worth it.
Author agreed it's not worth it and closed the PR.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with single commit by fasterthanlime (also maintainer).
Bot immediately posted binary size analysis within 1.3 minutes.
fasterthanlime posted codspeed results and mentioned ThouCheese.
ThouCheese commented that improvement was not significant for the actual workload.
fasterthanlime agreed and closed the PR ~2h after creation.
